dedupe_keys.name: flood sq m 16 event data sets wfp automated disaster analysis mapping on hdx

description: Flood sq m (16 event data sets, WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. ADAM ID: FL-20230301-MOZ-00 Flood covering 502890.0 sq m on Mar 01 2023 in Mozambique. It impacted 401099 people. Coverage: Ethiopia, Kenya, Madagascar, Malawi, Mozambique, Somalia and 1 more. The portal lists 16 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, GEOTIFF, TXT. The portal shows 2024-12-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
